# Explain the Scope and Impact of Your Most Important Project

[← Rippling](../README.md) · [Every Rippling question](../../rippling.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-the-scope-and-impact-of-your-most-important-project)

---

What is the most impactful project you have worked on? Outline its scope, your responsibilities, whether it was a collaborative effort or largely independent, its duration, and the final impact.

### Constraints & Assumptions
Use a genuine project. Distinguish the team's overall achievement from your personal contribution, and separate measurable impact from assumptions or anecdotes.

### Clarifying Questions
Who was the beneficiary and what changed? Which decisions and deliverables were yours? Who else took part? What drove the timeline?

### What a Strong Answer Covers
A clear starting point, a bounded scope, personal and team roles, a believable sequence of work, and evidence supporting the result.

### Follow-up Questions
Which milestone removed the greatest risk? What would the outcome have been without your input? How did you measure the impact after launch?

Overview:
Walk through an impactful project via its scope, your personal and the team's ownership, timeline, milestones, and results backed by business or user evidence.
